statement: Discard this Candidate. The 22.4% exact Probe queue reduction is real, but it is a local acceleration that changes die arrival phase faster than the commissioned packaging/burn-in/shipping system can absorb it. Ten fewer devices cross the terminal boundary and average WIP increases, so the intervention violates its own non-displacement guard despite the legacy Benchmark's baseline-relative KEEP label. Retain qualified-high-throughput-95 only as an explicit catalog capability and negative experiment boundary; do not apply it to the commissioned Blueprint. Any future Probe acceleration must be co-designed with the downstream handoff rather than revising this isolated mode.
